key_finding: sale_purchase auto-generates PO lines from service SO lines on confirmation via purchase_order_line.sale_line_id FK; no wizard; physical replenishment is out-of-scope

key_fields.purchase.order.line.sale_line_id: Many2one → sale.order.line; btree_not_null index; canonical SO→PO link
key_fields.purchase.order.line.sale_order_id: related via sale_line_id.order_id; derived SO header ref
key_fields.sale.order.line.purchase_line_count: Integer computed via _read_group; used as gate condition
key_fields.purchase.order.has_sale_order: Boolean technical field; same compute as sale_order_count

key_methods.sale.order.line._purchase_service_genera: Idempotent entry point; checks service_to_purchase and purchase_line_count==0
key_methods.sale.order.line._purchase_service_create: Core PO/PO-line creation; matches or creates PO; returns sale_line_purchase_map
key_methods.sale.order.line._match_or_create_purchas: Reuses existing draft PO for same partner/company/SO
key_methods.sale.order.line._purchase_increase_order: Updates draft PO qty or creates new PO line for delta
key_methods.sale.order.line._purchase_decrease_order: Schedules activity warning on PO; no auto-reduction
key_methods.purchase.order._compute_dest_address_id: Copies shipping address from SO to PO when single destination

scope_note: This module covers service outsourcing ONLY. Physical product make-to-order replenishment (stock routes/orderpoints) is handled by sale_stock/purchase_stock — outside this module.
manual_link_mechanism: NONE — all SO→PO links are system-generated automatically
migration_risks: company_dependent field service_to_purchase must be migrated per-company
sale_line_id FK on purchase.order.line must be preserved with data integrity check
purchase_line_ids One2many inverse must be re-verified after migration
access group references (purchase.group_purchase_user, sales_team.group_sale_salesman) must exist in target

claims.claim: service_to_purchase flag on product triggers auto-PO
SO confirmation calls _purchase_service_generation on all lines
guard: purchase_line_count==0 prevents duplicate PO lines
purchase.order.line.sale_line_id is the canonical FK link
SO header has purchase_order_count smart button (purchase users only)
PO header has sale_order_count and has_sale_order fields
system reuses existing draft PO for same supplier+SO before creating new
SO line qty increase updates draft PO qty or creates supplemental PO line
SO line qty decrease schedules activity warning; no auto PO reduction
SO cancellation schedules warning on generated POs
PO cancellation schedules warning on originating SOs
new SO line on confirmed SO fires PO generation immediately at create
PO inherits shipping address from SO when single destination
no wizard for manual SO→PO linking exists in this module
